# Miry Giramondo

> > Solo female travel blog by Miriam Ferrarin featuring adventure guides to off-the-beaten-path destinations including Afghanistan, Yemen, Socotra, Iraq, and beyond.

Miry Giramondo is a travel resource created by Friulian backpacker Miriam Ferrarin, specializing in budget travel guides to challenging and unconventional destinations across Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. The site offers practical visa information, destination guides, and firsthand accounts of solo female travel adventures.

## Key Topics

- Solo female travel
- Afghanistan travel guides
- Yemen and Socotra
- Budget backpacking
- Miriam Ferrarin

- Iraq and Middle East travel
- Turkey and Istanbul
- Italy and Sardinia destinations
- Termez, Uzbekistan
- Slovenia travel
- Long-term travel tips
- Off-the-beaten-path destinations
- Europe travel guides
